description: This file defines a utility class `StringUtils` with static methods for string manipulation, including case-insensitive operations and method name extraction.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string transformation and analysis, such as converting to lowercase, case-insensitive string search, and extracting method names from a string.

methods.name: string toLower(const string & input)
methods.description: Converts the input string to lowercase using std::transform.

methods.name: bool rfindInsensitive(const string & reference,const string & key)
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive rfind to check if the key exists within the reference string.

methods.name: bool checkStartsWithCaseInsensitive(const string & method,const string & key)
methods.description: Checks if the method string starts with the key string in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: string extractMethodName(const string & method)
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a string assumed to be in dot notation, converting it to lowercase. Logs an error if the format is invalid.

ctags.name: checkStartsWithCaseInsensitive
ctags.pattern: /^    static bool checkStartsWithCaseInsensitive(const string& method, const string& key) {$/

ctags.name: rfindInsensitive
ctags.pattern: /^    static bool rfindInsensitive(const string& reference, const string& key) {$/
